name: Look To The Stars
summary: Viktori Prism'Antras needs Blind Mary's looking glass for his telescope in Darkshire. An Insane Ghoul took it to Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in southern Duskwood.

sections.title: A Relic of Better Days
sections.body: Blind Mary once treasured an ornate looking glass. After an incident took her sight and sanity and left her a weeping spirit, she threw it into the dirt behind her family barn. Now the astronomer Viktori Prism'Antras needs the mirror for his telescope in Darkshire. The looking glass was taken long before he began studying the heavens.

sections.title: The Graveyard Scavenger
sections.body: An Insane Ghoul scavenged the looking glass from behind the ruined farmsteads. Restless hunger drove the undead creature south, carrying the mirror to Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. It haunts an abandoned chapel among the overgrown tombstones. You face the flesh-eating horrors of the southern woods to reclaim Mary's lost treasure from its rotting claws.

faq.q: Why does Viktori need Mary's looking glass?
faq.answer: Viktori Prism'Antras needs Mary's looking glass for the telescope he is assembling in his hut up the hill in Darkshire. Its reflective surface meets the optical needs of his invention, which gathers dim starlight.

faq.q: Who is the Insane Ghoul that stole the mirror?
faq.answer: The Insane Ghoul is an undead scavenger that gathered trinkets from abandoned homesteads near Mary's house. It fled south to the ruined chapel in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

faq.q: Why did Blind Mary throw her looking glass away?
aliases: why did mary throw it away
faq.answer: Blind Mary threw away her looking glass after an incident took her sight, tore her mind, and bound her as a restless shade. Unable to bear looking at or holding it, she cast it behind her barn in despair.

faq.q: Where is the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery?
faq.answer: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies in southeastern Duskwood, south of the main road. Once a peaceful burial ground for Duskwood's people, it is now infested with aggressive ghouls, skeletons, and carrion beasts.
Cog is a gnome tinkerer who lives in Darkshire. Viktori relies on Cog's engineering skill to assess and help build the delicate mechanisms of his star-viewing machine.

faq.q: What happens after returning the mirror to Viktori?
aliases: look to the stars next quest
faq.answer: The mirror brings Viktori closer to completing his apparatus. He moves on to the final stage of assembling his telescope and asks for one last component for its lens system.

angles.text: Engineers can appreciate how Viktori adapts ordinary polished hand mirrors into reflective parts for an astronomical instrument.
As a priest, you can witness the terrible fate of Duskwood's dead in Tranquil Gardens Cemetery, where fallen villagers have become insane scavengers.
As an Alliance member, you see the bitter fate of Duskwood's people when lost town relics fall into the hands of ravenous undead on the dangerous fringes of the Kingdom of Stormwind.
